text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That day was just another "ordinary" day, too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I finished the slope run~!
choice_data_list: Good work, let's take a break—

text_block_list.name: Voice from the East
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... This is bad.
To think the course is unavailable... What should we do?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, is someone in trouble...?
Trainer, I'm just going to—

text_block_list.name: Voice from the West
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, someone help!
Gold Ship-san is—?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
!! I hear voices from over there too...!
But... what should I do?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...! Thank you very much!
I'll join you right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black is always looking out for others. On that day too, she noticed troubles popping up one after another, helped out the girls in need, and then—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Phew~...
I'm so glad I managed to resolve all those worries.
choice_data_list: We got some solid training in.
We got some solid training in, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's because you helped me so much too, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for always
dragging you into my messes!
choice_data_list: If anything, I'm honored to help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to help people in need—that's her only motive
for running around. It's only natural to want to support
a girl who acts solely for the sake of others.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...!
Trainerrr...!
choice_data_list: Take it easy and get some rest today.
Get some good rest today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer,
are you heading home already?"
choice_data_list: I'm gonna keep working a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see...
...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe, pardon me for intruding.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Um, well...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Kita-chan's house-call massage service is here!
I came to loosen you right up, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! You might already know this, but I'm really good at giving massages!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A special massage taught directly by my mom! When I was little, I was always full of energy thanks to her!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I really want you to experience that prized technique for yourself, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I can't let you do that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Is it not okay...
just because that's what I want to do...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "I'm always thinking about it. How I want to support you too, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "Saying, 'Thank you as always!' Asking, 'Is there anything troubling you?' Wishing that if there's anything they can do, they want to help..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm really confident in my massages!
So... is that still not enough?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yes, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right! Where should I
start massaging first?
choice_data_list: Ask them to focus on your lower back.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me!
Here I go~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hup... Hup...! Trainer,
let all that tension in your legs melt away~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So you can run faster too...
Wait, you don't really need that, do you, Trainer?
Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The heartfelt, firm massage
unwound both body and soul...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me!
Alright, lie down please!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, how about this~?
...Whoa?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, are they asleep?
Sleep well, and sweet dreams...――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A soothing massage that invited slumber
unwound both body and mind...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me!
Alright, I'll go around behind you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hup... hup...
How's that? Pretty impressive, huh!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
People used to line up around the block
just to get a shoulder massage from me!
And on top of that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The delightful massage accompanied by reminiscing
relaxed both body and mind...
